title: No customer support at all
body:
I used to be a happy user of Way of Life and even paid for the premium version. However, after switching to a new phone, I discovered that I can no longer access the premium features I had paid for.

I tried reaching out to Way of Life through multiple channels — email, social media — but received no response at all. It’s extremely frustrating that a product marketed as a one-time purchase does not actually carry over when you change devices. Even with my original email and account, there’s no clear way to restore access to what I paid for.

What’s even more disappointing is the complete lack of customer support. It feels like there is no one behind the product. If you ever run into issues, you’re on your own.

I would caution others before buying the premium version. Be aware that your purchase may only last as long as your current device. Sadly, the customer support is practically non-existent, which makes the whole experience very frustrating.

body:
great app, if you start using this, your productivity and well being really will improve. Great that you only pay once to switch to premium, and not a monthly or yearly subscription. 

Some other people have complained you cant set a frequency for a habit (eg no junk food for 5 out of 7 days). Instead you just put the number in the title (eg exercise 4 days this week), then you just put 'skip' for the days when you don't exercise. It's up to you to put an (X) for a day when you have broken the chain: eg exercise for 4 days might be : Y-Y--YX .. because you got to the end of the week and hadn't exercised 4 times.
